about.heading: About Me
about.summary: Experienced Backend Developer with 5+ years of expertise designing, developing, and deploying high-performance software solutions. Currently at EPAM Systems, delivering scalable enterprise-grade applications for global clients across industries including Life Sciences and Healthcare. Passionate about clean architecture, cloud-native systems, and leveraging AI to build smarter software.

epam.bullet_1: Life Sciences: Salesforce integration connecting internal services to enable end-to-end order management for cancer detection blood tests (Java, Spring Boot, gRPC, Kafka, AWS).
epam.bullet_2: Oracle Health: Backend Engineer building the Patients Portal API using Java (Micronaut) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
epam.bullet_3: Participating in API development for the Patients Portal platform.
epam.bullet_4: Implementing integrations with OCI AI services.

mercadolibre.bullet_1: Places team: delivered technical solutions for connecting to the Mercado Libre logistics network (delivery and pickup points).
mercadolibre.bullet_2: Designed and developed high-performance, scalable backend systems using Java, Spring Boot, and Hibernate.
mercadolibre.bullet_3: Implemented RESTful APIs for data access and manipulation across logistics services.
mercadolibre.bullet_4: Collaborated with cross-functional teams using Agile methodologies and JIRA.
mercadolibre.bullet_5: Developed synchronous and asynchronous logistic solutions.

ejercito.bullet_1: Conducted investigations into potential threats to military security including espionage and sabotage.
ejercito.bullet_2: Developed and maintained relationships with intelligence sources and informants.
ejercito.bullet_3: Performed security screenings of personnel with access to sensitive information and facilities.
ejercito.bullet_4: Provided risk assessments and threat mitigation advisory to military commanders.

cancerguard.name: CancerGuard
cancerguard.description: Salesforce integration connecting internal services to enable end-to-end order management for cancer diagnostic blood tests, from collection points to company laboratories.

sellers_comm.name: Sellers Communications
sellers_comm.description: Application informing users of cross-docking and drop-off logistics about situations at shipping points where Mercado Libre sellers send their products.

gmv_api.name: GMV API — Antifraud
gmv_api.description: Alerting transportation teams when a facility exceeded its money threshold to schedule package collection and prevent loss of high-value products.

schedule_events.name: Schedule Events API
schedule_events.description: Enabled shipping point operators to schedule closures for vacations or personal reasons, integrated with Sellers Communications to notify sellers and reduce NPS impact.

delivery_cart.name: Delivery Point Shopping Cart
delivery_cart.description: Enabled buyers to unify purchases from different sellers into one cart, received at a single delivery point with consolidated shipping costs.
